packs.name: Norway
packs.description: Norwegian sources first: SSB, FHI and Norges Bank, with search tips and known gaps.
packs.summary: Norwegian sources first: SSB and FHI (first-class adapters via search_catalog), Norges Bank for rates/FX. Use for questions about Norway or with no explicit geography.

packs.name: Finland
packs.description: Finnish sources first: Statistics Finland (StatFin), with Eurostat and DBnomics for comparisons.
packs.summary: Finnish sources first: StatFin (Statistics Finland, via search_catalog), Eurostat for EU/NUTS comparisons, DBnomics/ECB for cross-country and euro-area rates. Use for questions about Finland or with no explicit geography.

packs.name: US health surveys (NHIS/MEPS)
packs.description: Individual-level US health data: NHIS and MEPS via IPUMS, direct NCHS files, with honest fallbacks to aggregate sources.
packs.summary: US individual-level health data: IPUMS Health Surveys (NHIS/MEPS, needs a user key), NCHS direct files (NHANES, NHIS one-year CSV, no key), MEPS Stata files, CDC aggregate fallbacks (BRFSS/PLACES); plus BRFSS microdata, NSDUH/SAMHDA (substance use), NVSS + CDC WONDER, HRS (ageing panel), SEER (cancer registry), HCUP (hospital discharge, purchase), CMS DE-SynPUF (synthetic claims for prototyping), MIMIC-IV/eICU (critical care, demo open) and All of Us (enclave). Covers the 2025-26 CDC/NCHS suspensions (PRAMS, NAMCS/NHAMCS). Use for health status, insurance, healthcare use, expenditure, ageing and mortality questions.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: BRFSS
packs.description: CDC's state-representative annual survey of adult chronic-disease risk factors and behaviors.
packs.summary: US state-representative adult health microdata (~400k/yr), open XPT downloads, no key. Best for state-level chronic-disease prevalence; weight with _LLCPWT; 2011 weighting break.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: NSDUH / SAMHDA
packs.description: SAMHSA's national survey of substance use, substance use disorders and mental health, ages 12+.
packs.summary: US person-level substance use and mental health microdata (age 12+), open public-use files (SPSS/SAS/Stata) with click-through access; restricted-use with finer geography needs application. Weight with ANALWT_C; no state identifier in public-use files; treat 2020-21 as a COVID-disrupted break.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: NVSS natality/mortality files
packs.description: CDC/NCHS record-level public-use birth and death files.
packs.summary: Record-level US birth (~3.6M/yr) and death (~3.3M/yr) public-use files, open (identified/geo-detailed versions need application); mirrored at NBER. Distinct from CDC WONDER, which only returns aggregated tabulated cells.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: CDC WONDER
packs.description: CDC's aggregated-query API for mortality, natality and other public health statistics.
packs.summary: CDC's query API returning aggregated, suppressed (<10) tabulated cells — NOT microdata. POST-only with an XML request/response format, no OpenAPI spec; keep automated use to about one query per 2 minutes and confirm the current mortality database id before querying.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: HRS
packs.description: NIA/SSA biennial panel study of US adults aged 50+ covering health, wealth and retirement.
packs.summary: US ageing panel (age 50+ and spouses, biennial since 1992) from NIA/SSA/University of Michigan; public files need free registration, restricted biomarker/genetic/geographic files need application. Start from the RAND HRS Longitudinal File, pre-cleaned and harmonized across 15+ waves.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: HCUP
packs.description: AHRQ's all-payer US hospital administrative discharge data (NIS/NEDS/KID/SID).
packs.summary: The largest US all-payer hospital administrative data (NIS/NEDS/KID/SID) — diagnoses, procedures, charges/costs, length of stay; purchase only (account, training, signed DUA, fee). Weight with DISCWT (TRENDWT for series spanning the 2012 discharge-level redesign); HCUPnet gives a free aggregate alternative.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: MIMIC-IV
packs.description: MIT's de-identified critical-care electronic health record database.
packs.summary: Critical-care EHR microdata from the MIT Laboratory for Computational Physiology; full access needs PhysioNet credentialing (CITI training, signed DUA, human review), but a ~100-patient demo needs none. Dates are randomly shifted per patient — within-patient intervals are valid, absolute calendar time is not.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: European survey microdata (ESS/SHARE/GESIS)
packs.description: European individual-level surveys: ESS via its open API, plus honest guidance for SHARE, GESIS, WVS/EVS and UKDS.
packs.summary: European individual-level survey data: ESS (machine-reachable API, needs a free user ID) and CESSDA (metadata search) first; SHARE (with easySHARE as the recommended entry point) and its g2aging harmonisation hub, SOEP, Understanding Society, ELSA, TILDA, GGP, GESIS holdings (Eurobarometer/ISSP/ALLBUS/EVS), UK Data Service, WVS, Eurostat EHIS/EU-SILC and LIS — login- or form-walled sources are described honestly with fallbacks to Eurostat/OECD aggregates. Use for attitudes, welfare, health, ageing, values.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Global development surveys (DHS/WB/barometers)
packs.description: Households and individuals in low- and middle-income countries: DHS indicators, World Bank Microdata search, regional barometers.
packs.summary: Households and individuals in low- and middle-income countries: DHS indicator API and World Bank Microdata Library (wbmicro, metadata search) are machine-reachable and keyless; MICS (UNICEF), WHO STEPS (NADA-based NCD microdata), WHO SAGE, HAALSI (fully open ageing panel), the g2aging LMIC sister studies (CHARLS/LASI/MHAS/KLoSA/JSTAR), World Values Survey, Afrobarometer/Latinobarometro/Arab/Asian Barometer and Global.health; GBD/GHDx flagged as modelled estimates, not microdata. Worldbank/WHO/OWID as aggregate fallback.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: US social surveys (GSS/PUMS/Pew)
packs.description: US attitudes and demographics at the individual level: GSS direct downloads, Census PUMS, and gated Pew data.
packs.summary: US attitudes, demographics and social behavior at the individual level: Census PUMS (ACS/CPS, needs CENSUS_API_KEY) and GSS (open Stata downloads, no key) are machine-reachable; Pew Research is login-walled. For US health surveys, use the separate 'US health surveys' pack instead.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Education & skills (PIAAC/PISA/TALIS)
packs.description: OECD skills and education microdata: PIAAC per-country CSVs (usable), PISA/TALIS honestly labeled as too heavy.
packs.summary: OECD skills and education microdata: PIAAC per-country CSVs are the usable sweet spot (open, no CORS via proxy); PISA and TALIS are open but far too heavy (hundreds of MB) — use OECD aggregate tables instead. Plus NAEP (US, restricted but NAEPprimer open for development), NCES longitudinal studies, the Urban Institute Education Data Portal API, IPEDS, College Scorecard, England's NPD-linked cohorts, Germany's NEPS, and the IEA family (TIMSS/PIRLS/ICILS/ICCS). Explains the plausible-values and replicate-weight rules that apply across the whole domain.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Data catalogs and discovery engines (NADA/Dateno/CKAN/HF/Kaggle)
packs.description: How to search for microdata programmatically: catalog software families, cross-catalog search engines and government/ML data portals.
packs.summary: Discovery and catalog-search infrastructure, not a source of values itself: the NADA family (wbmicro/ihsn built-in adapters, plus the shared API behind ILO/FAO/UNHCR/WHO STEPS instances), Dateno and dataportals-registry for cross-catalog search, government open-data portals (CKAN, Socrata — cdc is a built-in example, data.europa.eu), ML hubs (hf and kaggle built-in adapters; OpenML/UCI), and social-science archives (ICPSR, UK Data Service, GESIS, CESSDA built-in adapter). Use to find where data lives before reading it through the app's own tools.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Dateno
packs.description: Cross-catalog dataset search engine indexing ~19M dataset records across thousands of catalogs.
packs.summary: A discovery layer that indexes ~19M dataset records across thousands of catalogs and links back to the source portal — it does not host files itself. Requires an API key from my.dateno.io; no built-in adapter exists, so probe the API directly. Python client and free-tier terms unverified.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: dataportals-registry
packs.description: Registry of ~13,877 data portals (not datasets), searchable via bulk export files.
packs.summary: A registry of data PORTALS, not datasets: ~13,877 catalog/portal records and 136 software-platform definitions, sliced by country and type. No public API yet — consume the bulk files (catalogs.jsonl/full.parquet/datasets.duckdb) and filter by type=microdata or software=NADA to find which catalog to query next.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: CKAN
packs.description: Catalog software family behind government open-data portals (data.gov, data.gov.uk, and hundreds more).
packs.summary: Open-data catalog software running data.gov, data.gov.uk and hundreds of national/city portals. Open read access, no key. Query any deployment's package_search API for discovery, then resource_show/datastore_search to reach the actual file or table.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Socrata
packs.description: Catalog software family behind SODA/Socrata open-data portals; the cdc registry source is a built-in example.
packs.summary: Open-data catalog software (SODA) behind portals such as the built-in cdc source. Open, no key required (a free X-App-Token avoids throttling). Two-step flow: the discovery API returns the hosting domain + resource id, then query that domain's SODA endpoint directly with a $where filter.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: data.europa.eu
packs.description: The EU's open-data portal — search API plus SPARQL over DCAT-AP metadata.
packs.summary: The EU's open-data portal, covering member-state and EU-institution datasets. Open, no key. Use the search API for keyword discovery, or query the DCAT-AP metadata directly via SPARQL for structured filtering (e.g. by publisher or theme).
packs.author: hans

packs.name: OpenML
packs.description: ML benchmark dataset repository with parquet downloads and variable metadata.
packs.summary: ML benchmark dataset repository with 6,400 active datasets, overwhelmingly classic ML benchmarks (UCI classics, Kaggle mirrors) rather than primary statistical sources — use only for teaching/example datasets. Fully CORS-open and keyless; lookup is exact-name only (data_name/{name}, wrong name gives a 412), then data/{id} for metadata plus a direct parquet_url.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: UCI Machine Learning Repository
packs.description: Classic benchmark datasets used for teaching examples.
packs.summary: Classic machine-learning benchmark datasets — useful for teaching examples, not a primary statistical source. Open landing page; the ucimlrepo Python package gives programmatic access instead of scraping the page.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: ICPSR
packs.description: Large social-science data archive: tens of thousands of studies, 250,000+ files.
packs.summary: A large social-science data archive with tens of thousands of studies and 250,000+ files. Most studies need only a free account and click-through; restricted-use files need a Data Use Agreement or a secure enclave. The legacy OAI-PMH/DDI-XML bulk export is retired (guaranteed only until at least August 2026) — use the current metadata API instead.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Nordic registry microdata (Norway/Denmark/Sweden/Finland/Iceland)
packs.description: Individual-level Nordic population and health registries: microdata.no, Helsedata.no, and the Danish/Swedish/Finnish/Icelandic equivalents.
packs.summary: Norwegian, Danish, Swedish, Finnish and Icelandic register microdata: Norway's three access routes (microdata.no remote execution with its query language, Helsedata.no application costs/timelines, SSB data lending) and the health registries under it (NPR, KUHR, Reseptregisteret/NorPD, MFR, Dødsårsaksregisteret, Kreftregisteret, MoBa, CONOR, HUNT, Tromsø); Denmark (Forskermaskinen, Sundhedsdatastyrelsen); Sweden (MONA, Socialstyrelsen); Finland (Findata, THL); Iceland (Statistics Iceland, Landlæknir); the Nordic Commons policy vision. None of this is downloadable — always remote execution, enclave delivery, or application.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: microdata.no
packs.description: Remote-execution platform over Statistics Norway's administrative registers, with output-only anonymised results.
packs.summary: Server-side query platform over unmanipulated SSB register microdata (population, education, income/tax, FD-Trygd social security, employment, family/household, criminal justice; some series back to 1964) — health registries are NOT here, that's Helsedata.no. Access is institutional agreement, no per-project ethics application; no bulk export, only anonymised aggregated tables and model output leave the platform. Best for a fast (hours, not months), defensible answer from Norwegian register data when row-level access is not required.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Helsedata.no
packs.description: Norway's application portal for individual-level health-registry microdata, delivering to a secure enclave.
packs.summary: Single-application gateway to Norwegian health registries (NPR, KUHR, Reseptregisteret, MFR, Kreftregisteret and more), with delivery always to a secure enclave (TSD, SAFE or HUNT Cloud), never a raw file. Requires REK ethics approval, a GDPR legal basis and a DPIA; realistic timelines run 3-6 months and fees range roughly NOK 1,500 up to NOK 60,000 for complex linkage. Foreign researchers effectively need a Norwegian institutional data controller.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Sikt (Forskningsdatabanken/Surveybanken)
packs.description: Norway's national research-data archive, hosting freely downloadable survey data and distributing the European Social Survey.
packs.summary: Formerly NSD; distributes freely downloadable survey data from recurring Norwegian surveys, SSB, research institutes and individual deposits, much of it without application. Also hosts and distributes the European Social Survey (ESS) — see the europe-surveys pack for ESS-specific detail.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: SSB "utlån av data til forskere"
packs.description: Statistics Norway's arrangement for delivering genuine record-level files to a secure enclave, distinct from microdata.no.
packs.summary: Genuine record-level SSB register files delivered to a secure enclave (typically TSD) after a full project application — months, not hours — unlike microdata.no's output-only remote execution. Includes FD-Trygd, the linked social-security/labour-market event history (NAV benefit spells, unemployment, sick leave, disability).
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Danmarks Statistik — Forskningsservice
packs.description: Denmark's controlled-environment microdata access service (Forskermaskinen).
packs.summary: Genuine microdata access inside a controlled environment (Forskermaskinen), richer than microdata.no's Norwegian anonymised-output-only model. Foreign researchers need collaboration with or sponsorship by a Danish research institution.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: THL — Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare
packs.description: Finland's health-registry authority, running Hilmo, Cause of Death, Medical Birth and Infectious Diseases registers.
packs.summary: Runs Finland's core health registers — Hilmo (hospital discharge), Cause of Death, Medical Birth and Infectious Diseases — and publishes an open-data API for aggregate statistics.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: European national statistics microdata, per country
packs.description: Per-country routes to official-statistics microdata across Europe, faster or richer than the central Eurostat process.
packs.summary: Per-country routes to European official-statistics microdata (distinct from the slower central Eurostat process): Germany (FDZ Destatis, IAB, FDZ-RV, GESIS MISSY), France (CASD, ADISP/Progedo), Netherlands (CBS Microdata, ODISSEI), UK (ONS SRS, UK Data Service, ADR UK), Italy and Spain (directly downloadable — the open exceptions), Austria (AMDC), Switzerland (BFS), Ireland (CSO RMF/ISSDA), Belgium/Portugal/Poland/Czechia/Greece, plus EU-level infrastructure (Eurostat safe centres, CESSDA, IZA IDSC, the not-yet-operative EHDS). Nordic countries are covered in the nordic-microdata pack.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: CROS / CIMES country pages
packs.description: European Commission index of national microdata-access rules, one page per EU/EEA country.
packs.summary: A European Commission web page per EU/EEA country listing that country's current microdata-access portal, tier names and application process. Open, no application to browse the index itself — the underlying national sources each keep their own tiers. Use it as the starting point for any EU/EEA country not covered in detail elsewhere; it is a navigational directory, not a data source itself.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Administrative Data Research UK (ADR UK)
packs.description: UK initiative linking administrative and survey data for research access, split across four national governance regimes.
packs.summary: A UK-wide research-data-linkage initiative branded as one programme, but access actually routes through four separate regimes depending on which nation's data is needed: ONS SRS (ONS-held data under sharing agreements), NISRA (Northern Ireland government + health data), eDRIS (Scotland), and the SAIL Databank (Wales, billions of anonymised person-records). No single unified application exists — identify the relevant nation's gate first.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Labour market and firm microdata (LODES/QWI/IAB/firm registers)
packs.description: Worker, job, establishment and firm record-level data: openly downloadable US labour data plus European linked employer-employee sources.
packs.summary: Worker, job, establishment and firm microdata. US openly downloadable: LODES, QWI, BDS, CPS-ORG, QCEW, OEWS, JOLTS, O*NET, OSHA ITA, H-1B/PERM disclosure data; enclave-only: LBD/FSRDC. Europe: IAB SIAB/LIAB/BHP (JoSuA remote execution for non-residents), EU-LFS/SBS/CIS (aggregate open, microdata gated), open firm registers (GLEIF, UK Companies House, Norway's Enhetsregisteret, Denmark's CVR, Sweden's Bolagsverket), commercial ORBIS, EU-EFIGE and ECB SAFE/HFCS firm/household surveys, OECD MultiProd/DynEmp distributed computation, and the Nordic linked employer-employee registers.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: LEHD Origin-Destination Employment Statistics
packs.description: US Census Bureau census-block-pair job-flow data — home vs. workplace.
packs.summary: Census-block-pair job counts plus residence/workplace-area characteristics, 2002-2023, open, no key. Watch the cross-state 'aux' vs 'main' file split, and that LODES7 uses 2020 census blocks (not directly comparable to earlier vintages at block level).
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Quarterly Workforce Indicators
packs.description: Census Bureau establishment × demographic-group cell data on hires, separations and earnings.
packs.summary: Establishment × demographic-group cell data (not individual records), via a free-key Census API. Cells are suppressed or noise-infused when small, and state coverage start years differ.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Business Dynamics Statistics
packs.description: Open establishment/firm entry-exit-and-flow counts, the public derivative of the restricted LBD.
packs.summary: Establishment/firm counts and flows by age, size, industry and state/metro, 1978-2023, open. Firm age is topcoded; NAICS revisions break the series at 1997/2002/2007/2012/2017.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: CPS Outgoing Rotation Group
packs.description: Individual worker-month microdata from CPS-ORG, distributed as open CEPR uniform extracts.
packs.summary: Individual worker-month microdata, open CEPR uniform extracts updated monthly, 1979-present. Earnings are top-coded, and occupation/industry coding changed in 2002/03 and again in 2020.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages
packs.description: Near-census establishment employment and wage data from unemployment-insurance wage records.
packs.summary: Establishment-level near-census (~95% of US jobs), open CSV slices by industry/area/size. Excludes self-employed, some agricultural/railroad and most military workers; small county cells suppressed.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics
packs.description: Occupation × industry × area wage and employment cells, open annual download.
packs.summary: Occupation × industry × area cell data, open. SOC revision years (2010, 2018) and OMB metro redefinitions break the series.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey
packs.description: Establishment survey on job openings, hires and separations, open aggregate series.
packs.summary: Establishment survey published as open aggregate series since 2000, not microdata. State-level estimates are modelled/experimental with wide intervals.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: BLS Public Data API v2
packs.description: General-purpose BLS time-series API — the access layer behind CPS, QCEW, OEWS and other BLS series.
packs.summary: Time-series API, free registration key. Limits: 500 queries/day, 50 series/request, 20 years of history per request.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: OSHA Injury Tracking Application
packs.description: Open establishment-level workplace injury/illness data, 2016-present.
packs.summary: Form 300A annual summaries plus case-level Forms 300/301, open, 2016-present. Only establishments above size/industry thresholds report, and there is no stable establishment ID across years.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: OFLC disclosure data (H-1B LCA, PERM, H-2A, H-2B)
packs.description: Open individual-case disclosure data for US labour-certified visa programs.
packs.summary: Employer, worksite, offered wage and SOC code per case, open, FY2008-present. Field names/schema change across years, employer names are unstandardised, and LCA ≠ PERM ≠ actual visa issuance.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: EU Labour Force Survey
packs.description: The EU's harmonised individual/household labour-force microdata.
packs.summary: Open public-use files are training/methods only, NOT valid for population inference; genuine inference needs the Scientific Use File application (universities, research institutes, NSIs, central banks within the EU, plus the ECB). ISCO-88→ISCO-08 (~2011) and NACE Rev.1→Rev.2 (~2008) break long series.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Community Innovation Survey
packs.description: Enterprise-level innovation-activity survey, biennial since the 1990s.
packs.summary: Enterprise unit, biennial since the 1990s; microdata via application. Sample survey — weights required; firm-size thresholds and national implementation vary despite a harmonised questionnaire.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier data
packs.description: Open, keyless Legal Entity Identifier registry.
packs.summary: Cross-country firm identifier/linking key, open, no key. Not a firm census in itself.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: UK Companies House
packs.description: The UK company register — open bulk file plus a registered API.
packs.summary: ~5M companies via open bulk file, plus free-registration API for live lookups. Basic bulk extract excludes officers/PSC data and financial-statement figures — financials need the separate XBRL bulk product.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Enhetsregisteret (Norway)
packs.description: Norway's business register, open API and bulk download.
packs.summary: Open, keyless API and bulk download. Search is capped at 10,000 results — use bulk endpoints for a full extract; accounting figures live in a separate dataset (Regnskapsregisteret).
packs.author: hans

packs.name: ORBIS / Bureau van Dijk (Moody's)
packs.description: Commercial global firm financial-statement database.
packs.summary: Commercial licence, typically via a university library or WRDS. Financial-statement depth varies hugely by country (rich UK/DE/FR, thin elsewhere); bulk extraction is contractually capped.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: EU-EFIGE / Bruegel-UniCredit dataset
packs.description: Openly downloadable manufacturing-firm survey covering seven European countries.
packs.summary: Manufacturing firm unit (AT, FR, DE, HU, IT, ES, UK), open. Single survey wave (~2008-2010), not a panel on the survey side; stratified by size/country so weights required; manufacturing only.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: ECB Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises
packs.description: SME/firm-level survey on access to finance.
packs.summary: SME/firm unit, semi-annual/annual since 2009, free registration. Repeated cross-section with rotation, not a true firm panel.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Demography, migration, housing and time use
packs.description: Population, mortality/fertility, migration, housing and time-use microdata, with an explicit warning on what is aggregate-only.
packs.summary: Population structure, mortality/fertility, migration, housing and time use. Warns which sources are aggregate-only (HMD/HFD/STMF, UN WPP, Eurostat demo_*/migr_*, OECD DIOC, every population grid) versus true microdata: census microdata (IPUMS International, UK/France/Spain national releases, US post-differential-privacy PPMF), migration surveys (UNHCR Microdata Library, IOM DTM, MAFE, MIGNEX), housing/consumption (ECB HFCS, Eurostat HBS, American Housing Survey, RECS, Consumer Expenditure Survey, UK Land Registry Price Paid), and time use (MTUS, HETUS, ATUS).
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Human Mortality Database
packs.description: Free-registration database of aggregate period/cohort life tables, death counts and exposure for ~41 countries.
packs.summary: Aggregate period/cohort life tables, death counts, exposure and births (not individual records) for ~41 countries, with Sweden's series back to 1751 and most others from the early 1900s. Free registration; login moved in ~2022 to mortality.org/Account/Auth, so use HMDHFDplus >= 2.x.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Short-Term Mortality Fluctuations
packs.description: Open weekly all-cause mortality series by country, sex and broad age group from the Human Mortality Database.
packs.summary: Weekly all-cause deaths by country/sex/broad age group, open with no login (unlike core HMD) — the fast route for excess-mortality and mortality-shock monitoring. Weekly figures are provisional and revised, and age groups are coarse.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: UN World Population Prospects
packs.description: UN's aggregate population estimates and projections API and bulk files.
packs.summary: Aggregate population estimates 1950-2023 plus projections to 2100, open access via API (population.un.org) or bulk files. CSV responses begin with a 'sep=|' header line to skip; prefer the bulk files or wpp2024 package for a vintage-consistent full indicator set.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: IPUMS International
packs.description: Harmonised individual/household census microdata for 90+ countries via the IPUMS extract API.
packs.summary: True microdata — harmonised individual/household census records for 90+ countries, covering census rounds from the 1800s to 2020 (most from the 1960s). Registration required, some extracts need extra approval; not every country releases individual-level microdata. Uses the same stateless extract API as the rest of IPUMS.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: France — INSEE census fichiers détail
packs.description: INSEE's openly downloadable individual and household census extracts for France.
packs.summary: True microdata — individual and household extracts from France's rolling annual census, aggregated to region/department/canton/city geography. Open, freely downloadable from insee.fr. Weight with IPONDI; counts below ~200 are flagged imprecise and zones under 2,000 inhabitants are excluded from complementary tables.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: US decennial census — post-DP microdata
packs.description: Census's differentially private Privacy-Protected Microdata File, successor to decennial PUMS.
packs.summary: Individual-level, differentially private, block-level-geography microdata file (PPMF, released 5 Aug 2024) — Census's stated successor now that the ACS has replaced traditional decennial PUMS. Access tier is UNVERIFIED, likely restricted/approved-researcher; small-area counts show documented accuracy degradation vs pre-2020 products.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: MIGNEX
packs.description: Household survey on migration drivers and aspirations, with an open Zenodo variant.
packs.summary: True microdata — household survey on migration drivers and aspirations. An open-access variant is available on Zenodo, though it masks/aggregates some variables (e.g. precise geolocation) relative to the full dataset.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: ECB Household Finance and Consumption Survey
packs.description: ECB's euro-area household wealth, debt, income and consumption microdata.
packs.summary: True microdata on household wealth, debt, income and consumption across the euro area, waves in 2010/2014/2017/2021. Access requires application (government photo ID, English CV, request form). Each country-wave ships 5 multiply-imputed implicates — variance needs Rubin's rules, and several countries oversample wealthy households.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: American Housing Survey
packs.description: Open US housing-unit and household-level survey on quality, costs, tenure and neighbourhood.
packs.summary: True microdata at the housing-unit and household level — housing quality, costs, tenure, mortgages, neighbourhood and climate-risk modules. Open, no registration. Rotating panel with longitudinal housing-unit identifiers — merging across waves needs care with unit-ID continuity.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Residential Energy Consumption Survey
packs.description: EIA's open household energy-use and building-characteristics microdata.
packs.summary: True microdata on household energy use, appliances and building characteristics. Latest wave (2020, v7) covers ~18,500 households representing 123.5M primary residences, open access. Uses 96 replicate weights (Fay's BRR); sibling survey CBECS covers commercial buildings (latest full wave 2018).
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Consumer Expenditure Survey PUMD
packs.description: BLS's open household expenditure microdata.
packs.summary: BLS household expenditure microdata, open access, covering 1980-2024 (no PUMD for 1982-83); state identifiers for CA/FL/NY/TX from 2016.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data
packs.description: Open individual property transaction records for England and Wales.
packs.summary: True microdata — individual property transaction records for England & Wales, 1995-present, open under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Excludes some non-market transfers; Scotland and Northern Ireland publish their price-paid data separately.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Harmonised European Time Use Surveys
packs.description: Household and individual 10-minute time-diary microdata across Europe.
packs.summary: True microdata — household, individual, 10-minute diary records. Round 2 covers reference year 2010 across 17 countries including Norway; Round 3 (HETUS 2020) microdata not expected before 2027. Access requires application (Scientific Use Files); aggregate tables are open in the Eurostat Data Browser.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: National Historical Geographic Information System
packs.description: IPUMS's aggregate US summary tables and GIS boundaries, 1790-present.
packs.summary: Aggregate summary tables plus GIS boundaries for the US, 1790-present, via IPUMS (registration required). Boundaries are redrawn each census — match the boundary vintage to your tabulation year.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix
packs.description: IOM's site-level displacement data via API and HDX.
packs.summary: Open via API and HDX — mostly site-level aggregate data on displacement, though some Baseline/Household components approach microdata. Coverage is crisis-driven, not a standing global panel.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Crime, transport, energy and political behaviour
packs.description: Crime/justice, transport safety, energy/environment exposure and political-behaviour microdata — the most openly-downloadable domain in this collection.
packs.summary: Crime/justice, transport safety, energy/environment exposure and political behaviour — the domain with the most openly-downloadable microdata: NCVS, NIBRS, FJC Integrated Database, Stanford Open Policing (crime); FARS, CRSS, NHTS, BTS DB1B (transport); EPA AQS, EEA air quality, ERA5/CAMS exposure layers, and the EJScreen removal (energy/environment); ANES, CES, MEDSL, CSES, Manifesto Project, ParlSpeech/ParlGov (politics); plus a closed-since-2023 digital-trace landscape (Reddit/Common Crawl/GDELT open, Twitter/CrowdTangle closed).
packs.author: hans

packs.name: NCVS
packs.description: BJS's household/person/incident survey of US criminal victimization.
packs.summary: US household/person/incident-level victimization survey (1973-2024, redesigned 2016), open public-use with some ICPSR-restricted supplements. Excludes homicide; requires replicate weights; merge household/person files on YEARQ+IDHH; do not pool naively across the 2016 redesign.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: FBI NIBRS / UCR
packs.description: FBI's incident-level crime data for most US law-enforcement agencies via the Crime Data Explorer.
packs.summary: Incident-level US crime data (~18,000 agencies) with offense/victim/offender/arrestee segments, open bulk downloads (API needs a free api.data.gov key). National agency coverage was incomplete before ~2021; records multiple offenses per incident with no hierarchy rule, so totals differ from legacy UCR index-crime counts.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: NCRP
packs.description: BJS's individual-level annual prison admission, release and custody records from state DOCs.
packs.summary: Individual prison admission/release/year-end custody records, US state departments of corrections, 1991/2000-2021 annual, open (ICPSR public-use). State participation and variable completeness vary by year.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: FJC Integrated Database
packs.description: Federal Judicial Center's docket-level database of federal court cases.
packs.summary: Docket-level US federal court case data (civil, criminal, bankruptcy, appellate) from 1970/1979-present, fully open. Nature-of-suit codes changed over decades — use the Research Guide crosswalks; docket-level only, no document text.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Stanford Open Policing Project
packs.description: Stanford's open dataset of standardized US traffic and pedestrian stop records.
packs.summary: 200M+ individual traffic/pedestrian stops across US jurisdictions (~2000-2020), fully open. Standardisation quality and race-data availability vary by state; the project appears dormant since ~2020 — verify currency before claiming recent coverage.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: CSEW
packs.description: England and Wales's household/person/incident victimization survey.
packs.summary: Household/person/incident-level victimization survey for England and Wales, 1982-2024/25 annual, free UK Data Service registration (Special Licence for finer geography). Fraud/computer misuse only entered the headline series from ~2017 — a real break in comparability.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: NHTS
packs.description: FHWA's household/person/vehicle/trip survey of US travel behaviour.
packs.summary: US household/person/vehicle/trip travel survey (national plus state add-ons), NextGen 2022 latest wave, fully open. The 2022 GPS-assisted redesign is not fully comparable with earlier waves; jackknife replicate weights required.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: FARS
packs.description: NHTSA's census of US fatal motor-vehicle crashes.
packs.summary: Census (not a sample) of US fatal motor-vehicle crashes, crash/vehicle/person files linked per year, 50 states+DC+PR since 1975, fully open (R packages: rfars, crashapi). Fatal crashes only — pair with CRSS for non-fatal severity; coding schemes change across years.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: CRSS
packs.description: NHTSA's nationally representative sample of police-reported crashes of all severities.
packs.summary: Weighted sample of police-reported US crashes, all severities, 2016-2023 (2026 status unverified), fully open. WEIGHT variable required; never pool with FARS (a census) counts without adjustment.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: BTS airline / DB1B
packs.description: BTS's flight on-time performance data and a 10% sample of airline ticket data (DB1B).
packs.summary: US flight-segment on-time performance data plus a 10% sample of airline tickets (DB1B), fully open. DB1B needs weighting for market-share estimates; BTS appears to be renaming DB1B to DB1C circa 2025/26.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: EIA API v2
packs.description: EIA's aggregate time-series API for US energy production, prices, consumption and generation.
packs.summary: Aggregate US energy time series (production, prices, consumption, generation) via api.eia.gov/v2, open with a free key. Does NOT carry RECS/CBECS respondent-level microdata (flat-file only) — a common confusion point.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: EPA Air Quality System
packs.description: EPA's monitor-level air quality readings across the US.
packs.summary: Monitor-day/hour air-quality readings, US 1957 (sparse)-present (dense from the 1980s), open pre-generated files plus a free email-registered API. The API key is issued to an email by an EPA process, not an instant self-service token.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: ANES
packs.description: ANES's pre/post-election respondent survey of US political attitudes and behaviour.
packs.summary: US pre/post-election respondent survey, 1948-2024, open after free instant registration. Requires a login step rather than a bare URL fetch; weight variable names change every wave.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: CES
packs.description: Harvard's large annual respondent survey of US political attitudes (formerly CCES).
packs.summary: US respondent survey, ~50-60k+ per year, 2006-2024 annual, openly downloadable from Harvard Dataverse (click-through terms may appear). Pick the right file — Common Content vs team modules vs cumulative file — and note weight variable names differ by year.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: MEDSL
packs.description: MIT Election Lab's precinct-level US election returns.
packs.summary: Precinct x office x candidate x year US election returns, openly downloadable from Harvard Dataverse. Precinct boundaries change over time — match returns to the election-year vintage of the boundary shapefile.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: CSES
packs.description: A harmonised cross-national post-election respondent survey.
packs.summary: Harmonised cross-national post-election respondent survey, ~50 countries, Modules 1-5 spanning 1996-2021+, open after free registration (CSES or GESIS). Module-to-module harmonisation is imperfect — check each module's codebook for variable availability by country-year.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Manifesto Project (MARPOR)
packs.description: MARPOR's party-election manifesto database, quasi-sentence coded and aggregated to party-year.
packs.summary: Party-election manifestos, quasi-sentence coded and aggregated to party-year, 50+ countries since 1945, open after free instant registration (API key). list_core_versions, get_core_codebook and get_core_citation endpoints work without a key.
packs.author: hans

packs.name: Research data repositories (Dataverse/Zenodo)
packs.description: Replication and long-tail research data: Dataverse, Zenodo, OpenML and Figshare with access reality per platform.
packs.summary: Replication and long-tail research data: Zenodo (fully CORS-open, DOI-first) is cheapest to use; Dataverse (largest, ~300k datasets, needs proxy, expect 403s) and OpenML (ML benchmarks, exact-name lookup only) are usable; Figshare mostly skip (no CORS, signed URLs expire fast).
packs.author: hans
